introduction.description: FinanceAggregator is a fully containerized, event-driven distributed system hosted in the Azure cloud ecosystem. Backend microservices run as isolated Azure Container Apps that scale dynamically (0–1) for maximum cost-efficiency. State persistence is managed via managed PostgreSQL on Supabase, messaging is routed through CloudAMQP, and the frontend is served globally via Azure Static Web Apps.

items.name: Public CDN & Gateway Entry
items.description: The client SPA dispatches API requests to the public YARP Gateway container app.

items.name: Authentication & Registration
items.description: YARP routes traffic to the Identity Service, publishing user lifecycle events to CloudAMQP.

items.name: Out-of-Band Event Processing
items.description: The Wallet Service consumes message events to provision default user wallets directly inside Supabase.

items.name: Caching & Real-Time Sync
items.description: Application's state is cached using containerized Redis, while SignalR pushes live WebSocket updates back to the browser.

items.name: Azure Static Web Apps
items.description: Hosts the compiled SPA static assets and routes client traffic securely over HTTPS/WSS.

items.name: YARP Gateway
items.description: Public-facing entry point providing CORS termination, JWT validation, and reverse proxying.

items.name: Identity Service
items.description: Internal app handling user authentication and JWT token issuance within an isolated identity schema.

items.name: Wallet Service
items.description: Internal app managing financial balances and asset allocations, integrated with Redis and SignalR.

items.name: Notification Service
items.description: Decoupled background worker processing real-time audit logs and system events via CloudAMQP.

items.detail: React/TypeScript SPA, hosted in Azure Static Web Apps (Serverless Edge CDN)
YARP on Azure Container Apps (External Ingress)
C#/.NET Web APIs on Azure Container Apps
